scope: Single-shot paired comparison on reserved BabyAI-GoToLocal-v0 seeds 30000..30199 between frozen Phase 1 policy and frozen Phase 1 policy + unchanged Phase 4 ExternalObservationCountWrapper (no Phase 3, no tuning, no re-runs).

outcome_definitions.success: terminated and total_reward > 0.0 and exception is None
outcome_definitions.timeout: truncated and not terminated and exception is None (64-step limit)
outcome_definitions.exception: any runtime exception raised during episode reset, policy/wrapper inference, or env.step (halts evaluation and preserves partial records)

information_boundary: encode_observation and ExternalObservationCountWrapper consume only obs['image'] and obs['mission'] (and probs/reset); diagnostics (pose, hashes, front_blocked meta, reward) are logged offline only.

statistical_protocol.confidence_interval: Newcombe (1998) Method 10 paired Wilson score 95% CI with continuity-adjusted phi_hat when ad - bc > 0 and zero correlation fallback when any margin is zero
statistical_protocol.hypothesis_test: Exact two-sided McNemar binomial test on discordant pairs (n_01, n_10)
statistical_protocol.baseline_revisit_audit: Track repeated raw observations, overrides, and preserved-vs-regressed outcomes among baseline-successful episodes
